nota: Hero web de Contacto (efeoncepro.com/contacto). Registro cine aprobado por el operador el 2026-10-30 para este hero; caso 1 (Nexa protagonista). Conserva la pose de la foto anterior sin la línea lima dibujada.
escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark design studio at night): she sits at the far end of a long dark matte walnut table that runs toward the camera, on the RIGHT half of the frame, framed from the chest up: her head and shoulders fill the upper two thirds of the frame height, her face large and close, wearing the royal blue EFEONCE HOODIE, no lanyard, no smartwatch, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at the height of her eyes, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. POSE: her RIGHT forearm, on the frame-left side of her body, rises from the table and her chin rests lightly on her loosely closed right hand; her right elbow rests on the table at about 56% of the frame width; her left forearm lies flat on the table; the embroidered mark on her left chest stays fully visible, nothing in front of it. She looks straight into the lens with a warm, attentive expression, the face of someone who is listening to you. Between the left edge of the frame and her elbow there is a wide band of empty darkness. A bright, crisp ring of glowing teal light, clearly the brightest thing in the frame, hovers just above the table around her right elbow, no wider than her shoulders and entirely inside the right half of the frame, tilted up toward the camera so it reads as an open ellipse, never a flat line; it passes in front of her forearm and behind it. A short brighter teal arc of that ring carries ONE small cool-white sphere into the orbit, with the long-exposure light trail of a message that has just arrived, while she stays perfectly still and razor sharp. That glowing arc and its sphere are the only key light and it is STRONG and hard: a bright teal edge sculpts the frame-left side of her face, cheekbone, jaw and hand, the nose shadow falls clearly on her frame-right cheek, and the frame-right half of her face drops into deep shadow that still keeps detail; the glow only grazes the hoodie and never floods her chest. The haze above the ring catches its glow as a soft visible column of light rising toward her face. A crisp, bright cool rim light from behind and above separates her hair and shoulders from the dark. A slim premium aluminium laptop stands open at the right edge of the table, seen from its thin side edge, its screen off and dark, no glow on her, no logo and no marks. The whole frame is cool and contemporary: teal light against deep navy darkness, nothing warm, amber or golden. Rich contrast, punchy saturated teal, no text, no logos of any other brand.
